name: Contra Check Recovery (Promenade)
notes: Separate promenade alternative requested by the owner (2026-11-19); the closed recovery remains available unchanged. A three-count recovery from the same held Contra Check: replace weight onto lead RF / follow LF on 1 and unwind the contra shape, then step lead LF side / follow RF side into promenade on 2, developing/holding that shape through 3. Lead opens 45 degrees left and follow 45 degrees right, using the existing owner-agreed symmetric promenade model; this is a provisional visual timing/size proposal, not a standard syllabus transcription. The finish is the existing promenade-apart stance, lead LF / follow RF weighted, so Open Natural Turn can follow with no repositioning. No closing step or turn back to closed hold. Supporting feet stay in place; foot placements are explicit to avoid invoking a coupled travelling turn. No check exclusions.
